resources.string: ROOTLESS / PICO 4 PRO / NO OPENXR SESSION
Distinct valid source timestamps sent in the last second. OSC sends full snapshots at the selected rate. UDP has no delivery acknowledgment.
Channel switches apply immediately. Both off pauses capture. Both PICO tracking permissions are still required. Destination and rate apply on Start / Restart.
Tag: PicoFacialBridge. Summaries every 5 seconds; up to 160 recent lines. No expression values or automatic uploads. Logs may contain your PC IP.
Start the bridge, then use Virtual Desktop as usual. Enable OSC and native Face Tracking in VRChat. No PC module is needed. Pupil channels are unsupported. Use trusted Wi-Fi.
Enter the VRChat PC address, then tap Start.
Sending OSC snapshots; window may be closed. VRChat receipt is not confirmed.
Waiting for fresh tracking: wear/wake headset
Enter the destination PC IPv4 address
Both local transmission switches are off. Enable the channels you want to transmit.
Enable an eye or face channel
Eye and face permissions are required by the shared algorithm. Tap Start to try again.
Direct OSC sending service. Tap to view or stop.
UDP send failed; retrying. Check target IP and Wi-Fi.
Destination = computer running VRChat (no extra PC app)
Enter a valid PC IPv4, port 1–65535 and rate 30–120.
Off by default. Locally logs the 8 used direction source values and encoded eye bytes. Turn off after testing; resets when the app process exits.
